title: Korail Networks and Railway Customer Center branches' labor dispute and all-member strike
location: Multiple railway workplaces; January physical gatherings are recorded separately
organizer: Korail Networks and Railway Customer Center branches of the Korean Railroad Workers' Union
notes: OhmyNews dates the all-member strike to Nov. 11, 2020 and describes demands over a wage agreement and employment conditions. Yonhap reports that the all-member strike ended with workers returning from 3 p.m. on Jan. 15 and shifting to a cadre strike. That phase change is not treated as the end of the broader labor campaign. The roughly 1,000 strike-wide participants are not assigned to any January press conference, sit-in, or rally. January physical actions remain separate candidates pending attendance and unit review.
open_questions: When did the broader campaign or cadre strike physically end?
Were the January press conferences and sit-in separate escalations within this older-onset campaign or related actions with distinct event boundaries?
What was simultaneous turnout at each January gathering?
